title: Manifest SBOM Coverage
description: What the SBOM tool could not resolve when it read one commit's dependency manifests: each manifest it saw with nothing resolved beside it (no lockfile), by ecosystem. Stored as the artifact of a tool_scan assessment on the commit, beside its manifest SBOM. A package missing from the SBOM in an ecosystem listed here is unknown, never absent. An empty list is a complete read.

path.description: The manifest, relative to the repository root.

reason.description: no-lockfile: a manifest whose versions only a lockfile pins, with none beside it or above it in the tree.
